name: itkview-desktop
description: itkView desktop shell with an explicit shared itkFlow regression build.

scripts.sidecar:flow: uv run --project ../backend --extra desktop --locked python build-sidecar.py --variant flow
scripts.sidecar:view: uv run --project ../backend --extra desktop --locked python build-sidecar.py --variant view
scripts.dev: uv run --project ../backend --extra desktop --locked python build-sidecar.py --variant view && tauri dev
scripts.build: uv run --project ../backend --extra desktop --locked python build-sidecar.py --variant view --bundle
scripts.build:flow: uv run --project ../backend --extra desktop --locked python build-sidecar.py --variant flow --bundle
scripts.build:view: uv run --project ../backend --extra desktop --locked python build-sidecar.py --variant view --bundle
scripts.test:variants: uv run --project ../backend --extra desktop --locked python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_*.py
